1 MWe AEC electrolyzer stack based on Niklas Gerloff, Comparative Life-Cycle-Assessment analysis of three major water electrolysis technologies while applying various energy scenarios for a greener hydrogen production, Journal of Energy Storage, Volume 43, 2021, https://doi.org/10.1/j.est0.20.1. Single stack lifetime of 55'000 years @ 8000 hours/year, hence 3 replacements over 20 years. Produced amount of H2 over 27.5 years: 4,259,200 kg. The technology is available for large plant sizes and operates with a stack efficiency of up to 67 % (based on the lower heating value (LHV) of the generated H2). While the LCI data of the BoP components either originate from Zhang et al., based on a 300-kW system and, therefore, scaled-up to 1â€¯MW by a factor of 0.7, the LCI data of the other BoP components originate from manufacturer offers or have been estimated by own calculations using additional information by the producers. Stack lifetime: 7.5 years @ 8,000 hours per year. Replaced 3 times over systemÂ´s lifetime (27.5 years). For additional specifications, refer to Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C.
